summary: The compact raised studio, low hipped roof, red-brown palette, and side steps create a recognizable miniature, but the wall and window treatment misses key visible character.

orientation.summary: SV1 is geolocated southwest of the studio and looks NE, exposing the camera-facing -u and +v sides. Its broad -u wall has the off-center window, while the adjoining +v side carries the steps/entry. The labeled face sheet matches this arrangement, and the actual inventory contains one principal door only on +v (SSE, 149°), with no duplicated portal.

issues.problem: The model uses pronounced masonry/brick walls, while SV1 shows reddish-brown horizontal timber siding, a defining material cue.
issues.fix: Replace the brick pattern with simplified horizontal brown siding while retaining the pale corner and opening trim.

issues.problem: The broad-wall window reads as a wide paired, multi-pane unit rather than the reference’s single tall, narrow, off-center window.
issues.fix: Narrow the -u window to one vertically proportioned opening and preserve its asymmetric placement.
